page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

A primary characteristic of this instance type is its integrated local storage, consisting of 30717 GB of SSD capacity. This massive local storage capacity is paired with a high-speed network interface that delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps. The instance does not include any graphics processing units.

Given its high density of local SSD storage and substantial memory capacity, the ecs.i4.32xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high-capacity, low-latency local storage without the overhead of external storage attachments. This hardware profile is designed for large-scale databases, high-throughput storage systems, big data analytics, and intensive transactional processing workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.32xlarge is a high-capacity storage and database instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs operating at 2.7 GHz, alongside 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A defining feature of this instance is its substantial local storage capacity, which provides 30717 GB of SSD storage directly bundled with the hardware. Additionally, the instance supports a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps to facilitate rapid data transfer. Lacking dedicated GPUs, this server is optimized for data-intensive operations rather than graphical acceleration. The combination of dense local SSD storage, high memory capacity, and fast networking makes the ecs.i4.32xlarge highly suitable for large-scale databases, transactional applications, and data warehousing workloads.
